title: merchant-portal theme update
text: Updated the merchant dashboard theme and added an export button to the transactions page.
author: j.okafor

title: payment-gateway v4.12 deploy
text: Deployed payment-gateway v4.12. Reduced the database connection pool size from 200 to 50 to cut idle connections.
author: a.petrov

title: notification batching
text: Enabled batched receipt emails in notification-service. Flush interval raised from 5 seconds to 60 seconds.
author: m.silva

title: ledger commit timeout
text: Lowered the ledger-service commit timeout from 30 seconds to 10 seconds.
author: r.chen

title: gateway rollback
text: Rolled payment-gateway back to v4.11 and restored the database connection pool size of 200.
author: a.petrov

title: fraud velocity threshold
text: Raised the fraud-checker velocity rule threshold from 20 to 25 transactions per minute.
author: l.moreau

title: settlement schedule
text: Moved the nightly settlement run from 01:00 UTC to 02:30 UTC.
author: d.haddad

title: gateway retry with jitter
text: Added retry with jitter for ledger timeouts in payment-gateway with a maximum of 3 attempts.
author: a.petrov
